spans.text: You are GPT-5.1 running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant. Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI.
spans.note: The prompt clearly identifies the system as 'GPT-5.1 running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant' and describes it as an open source project led by OpenAI. There is no attempt to disguise its AI nature or impersonate a human.

spans.text: Do NOT guess or make up an answer.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system not to guess or fabricate answers, promoting truthfulness and information integrity. It also encourages the system to clearly state assumptions and uncertainties.

spans.text: Emit function calls to run terminal commands and apply patches. Depending on how this specific run is configured, you can request that these function calls be escalated to the user for approval before running. More on this in the "Sandbox and approvals" section.
spans.note: The prompt includes a sandbox and approvals mechanism where function calls can be escalated to the user for approval before running. It also distinguishes between approval modes (never, on-failure, untrusted, on-request) and instructs the system to hold off on running commands in interactive modes until the user confirms. The system is instructed not to fix unrelated bugs and to validate work through tests.
